text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Actually, I found a new aroma blend at my favorite shop yesterday!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The scent was so wonderful that I slept like a log all night.
That's why my mind and body feel so light!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Have you been sleeping well lately, Trainer?
If you'd like, I can share some with you next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only was I grateful for her thoughtfulness,
her beaming smile filled me with energy.
It seems she got some good rest.
